value.rationale: Canonical finite ternary Cantor sets have a full integer threefold sum interval yet highly nonuniform ordered representation counts. Their exact all-scale sixth moment is a natural complete numerical invariant beyond asymptotic multifractal dimensions, with a precise leading constant for collision excess. It is a motivated finite-level arithmetic classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a claim of a new general transfer-matrix method.
